summary: Frontend responsiveness regression for /clientes verified at 1920, 1366 and 390 viewports. NO horizontal scroll anywhere. Emprestimos page and Novo Empréstimo modal render correctly with no leftover emojis. No console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clientes responsive fix confirmed: desktop uses w-full table with truncated Nome/Email cols (6 truncated cells across 3 rows), mobile uses stacked cards (data-testid=cliente-card-<id>). No horizontal overflow at 1920/1366/390. Emprestimos and NovoEmprestimoModal are emoji-free. Note: The `[role=dialog]` selector for the Novo Empréstimo modal returned exists:false via evaluate(), but the modal clearly opens (screenshot verified) — the modal container likely lacks the ARIA role attribute; visually the redesigned header and clean 'Mensal' label are correct. Minor accessibility improvement: main agent could add role='dialog' to NovoEmprestimoModal wrapper for better a11y/testing.
